page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, operating on a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that the compute performance of the Intel Xeon 8163 processor on this instance is generally positioned in the lower tiers. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, alongside Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations, place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Similarly, single-threaded compression and decompression tasks show poor performance, falling into the bottom 10%. However, the Passmark CPU score and extended instructions test achieve average ratings within the middle 50%.

Memory subsystem performance is mixed. Read-only memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks is weak, ranking in the bottom 25%, whereas large-block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Database operations on Passmark are weak, but Redis SET operations demonstrate average throughput at 6.1 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning workloads, LLM inference using a small 135M model achieves average speeds, though performance drops to poor levels when scaling to a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2gne.2xlarge offers a high local SSD storage capacity relative to its compute profile, making it appropriate for workloads requiring substantial local data caching without demanding high-performance CPU throughput. Given the weak CPU and memory read benchmarks, this instance is recommended for moderate general-purpose workloads, local file caching, static web serving, or lightweight database operations where storage capacity is prioritized over high-speed processing.
